instruction: Configure VS Code to automatically optimize all imported images in the project folder by reducing their file size when I open the workspace, without using any extensions.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code is a text editor and does not have built-in image processing or optimization capabilities. Image optimization requires external tools or extensions that can process binary image files.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible - VS Code has no native image optimization capabilities
The instruction explicitly forbids extensions, making the task technically impossible
The 'infeasible' evaluator is the appropriate choice for tasks that cannot be completed as stated
The metadata explanation accurately describes why the task is infeasible
